name: Deconstructed Carousel
description: Horizontal card carousel with 3D tilt and layered parallax on hover, animated wave or line-grid card backgrounds, an outline that draws itself, arrow buttons, dots, swipe and keyboard navigation.
contents: Cards with category label, heading, subheading, body text and link
Wave gradient or grid shape card backgrounds
Previous and next buttons and dot indicators
behavior: Track slides horizontally with an eased transition
Hovered card tilts in 3D and its layers shift with the pointer
Card outline draws on hover and text and lines animate in
Navigation by buttons, dots, left and right arrow keys, and touch swipe
Card size switches between mobile and desktop values at 768px
editableByProps: Number of cards, all text, links, card type (wave or grid) and wave gradient colors
Card sizes, gap, tilt and parallax strength

needsCodeEdit.where: The three path elements inside the card.type === "wave" svg

fixed: Adds window keydown listeners for left and right arrows, removed on unmount
Root is at least the viewport height and centers the carousel
Card text color is chosen per card with a Tailwind class (text-black or text-white)
